ActorTalk: Hello, Gray Raven Commandant. This is the Sinking Light Cloisters... a place for everyone to contemplate.
As you can see, this place has become a gathering spot for troubled people recently.
If you have time, would you like to listen to everyone's troubles?
What about you? Don't you have any troubles?
There are, but I wouldn't say they're anything that needs to be dealt with urgently.
But if I had to say... I just hope things will get better from now on.
Not that I know how to make things better, though.
